Package com.github.workerframework.queues.rabbit

Class WorkerPublisherImpl

java.lang.Object
com.github.workerframework.queues.rabbit.WorkerPublisherImpl
All Implemented Interfaces:
WorkerPublisher
public class WorkerPublisherImpl extends Object implements WorkerPublisher
A RabbitMQ publisher that uses a ConfirmListener, sending data as plain text with headers. Messages that cannot be published at all cause a rejection of the input message (task) that triggered this published response.

  • Constructor Details

    • WorkerPublisherImpl

      public WorkerPublisherImpl(com.rabbitmq.client.Channel ch, RabbitMetricsReporter metrics, BlockingQueue<Event<QueueConsumer>> events, com.github.workerframework.queues.rabbit.WorkerConfirmListener listener) throws IOException
      Create a WorkerPublisher implementation. The channel will have confirmations turned on and the supplied WorkerConfirmListener will be added as a confirm listener upon the channel.
      Parameters:
      ch - the channel to use, will have confirmations enabled
      metrics - the metrics to report to
      events - the event queue of the consumer to ack/reject on
      listener - the listener callback that accepts ack/nack publisher confirms from the broker
      Throws:
      IOException - if the channel cannot have confirmations enabled
